tools.name: recognize_cards
tools.description: Identify trading cards in a photo with the NeoSatoshi card recognition API. Games: Pokémon (default), One Piece, Disney Lorcana, Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG, Magic: The Gathering and Star Wars: Unlimited, several cards per photo (binder pages work, one game per photo), and football (soccer) cards with tcg "football" (Topps, Panini and other makers; one card front per photo, max 4 MB). Returns per card: name, language, set, number, rarity, Cardmarket product ID, daily Cardmarket prices in EUR (TCGplayer USD where available), confidence and alternatives. Football cards instead: the player, release (set, number), season, subset, teams, rookie flag, a sure flag, alternatives and the parallel (three candidates with print runs, a pick only when the recognizer is sure; a person should confirm it). No prices and no images for football yet; it takes about 6 to 25 seconds. Graded slabs (PSA, BGS, CGC, for football also SGC) fill graded with the grade read from the label. It does not grade card condition. Give exactly one image source: image_path (local .jpg/.jpeg/.png, max 12 MB, football 4 MB), image_url (public https URL, forwarded to the API) or image_base64. Uses the API key in NEOSATOSHI_API_KEY; without it, the public demo key is used (10 detections per day per network). One card usually takes about 4 seconds, about 10 to 12 seconds on the first request after a quiet period.

image_path.description: Path to a local JPEG or PNG file (max 12 MB, football 4 MB). Absolute paths work best; ~ is expanded.

image_url.description: Public https URL of a JPEG or PNG (max 12 MB). Sent to the API as is; this server does not download it.

image_base64.description: Base64-encoded JPEG or PNG (max 12 MB, football 4 MB). A data:image/...;base64, prefix is accepted.

tcg.description: Which game the photo shows. Default: pokemon. football for football (soccer) cards.

tools.name: search_cards
tools.description: Search the NeoSatoshi card catalog. Results are full card objects like a detection returns (set, number, rarity, Cardmarket product ID, daily prices, images), at most 10, with has_more but no total. Use it first to fix a wrong detection: pass request_id and card_index from recognize_cards. That correction search is free (5 searches per detected card within 24 hours, at most 5 results), then call correct_card. Without request_id it is the paid card search: 0.5 credits when it returns a card, nothing for no result. Query: q (a card name, at least 3 letters, optionally with the number like "charizard 4/102", or a printed code like OP01-003), or set + number. Wildcards and set-only or number-only queries are refused. Football (tcg "football"): q only, the player with optional set or season words ("kane chrome 2023"), no language, set or number, no prices yet; each result carries a ref for get_card. Football detections cannot be corrected yet.

request_id.description: request_id of a detection: makes this a free correction search.

card_index.description: cards[].card_index of the card to correct (with request_id).

tcg.description: Game. Required without request_id; default with it: the detected card's game.

q.description: Card name (at least 3 letters), optionally with the number, or a printed code. Football: the player, optionally with set or season words.

set.description: Set id or code, together with number.

number.description: Card number, together with set (or q).

language.description: Card language, e.g. en, de, fr, it, es, pt, ja, ko, zh (per game). Default: the detected card's language, else en. Leave it out for football.

tools.name: correct_card
tools.description: Correct a card of a detection to the right catalog card. Free, within 24 hours of the detection, 3 times per card, only for the API key that made the detection. card_id comes from a correction search result or from the detected card's alternatives. Returns the full corrected card. Corrections also improve the recognition. Yu-Gi-Oh!: card_id is the passcode, set the printed code (LOB-EN001) to pick a printing. Magic: card_id is the oracle_id with set + number for the printing. One Piece: cardmarket_id picks a parallel.

card_index.description: cards[].card_index of the card to correct.

card_id.description: card_id of a search result or an alternative.

language.description: Card language, e.g. en, de, fr, it, es, pt, ja, ko, zh (per game). Default: the detected card's language, else en. Leave it out for football.

cardmarket_id.description: One Piece: picks a parallel printing.

set.description: Magic, SWU: set of the printing; Yu-Gi-Oh!: the printed code.

number.description: Magic, SWU: collector number of the printing.

tools.name: get_card
tools.description: Get one card by its card_id (for example to refresh its price or resolve a stored id). 0.5 credits when the card exists, nothing for an unknown card. For a wrong detection use search_cards with request_id and correct_card instead: those are free. Football: pass the ref of a search_cards result (same API key, within 24 hours); the card then comes with all parallels of its subset and their print runs. Without a valid ref the call is refused and free.

card_id.description: card_id (Yu-Gi-Oh!: passcode; Magic: oracle_id; SWU: printing id or card_key; football: fb-...).

ref.description: Football only, required there: the ref of the search_cards result for this card_id (valid 24 hours).

language.description: Card language, e.g. en, de, fr, it, es, pt, ja, ko, zh (per game). Default: the detected card's language, else en. Leave it out for football.

cardmarket_id.description: One Piece: picks a parallel printing.

set.description: Magic, SWU: set of the printing; Yu-Gi-Oh!: the printed code.

number.description: Magic, SWU: collector number of the printing.

tools.name: list_supported_games
tools.description: Lists the games, card languages, tcg values and limits of the NeoSatoshi card recognition API. No API call, no cost.
